title: malva tournefortiana var. colmeiroi
intro: Malva tournefortiana var. colmeiroi, commonly known as Mallow, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Malva tournefortiana var. colmeiroi are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and soothing properties, which can be beneficial for skin conditions and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
